title: Corduroy
original_lyrics:
[intro]
(at 8) (at 7) (at 10)
The waiting drove me mad.
You're finally here and I'm mess.
I'll take your interest back.

[chorus]
(1'st position)
I don't want to take what you can give.
(1'st position)
I would rather starve than eat your bread.
(1'st position)
I would rather run but I can walk.
(1'st position)
Guess I'll lie alone just like before.
(Intro)
I'll take the firmest path.
and I must refuse your test.
Push me and I will resist.
This behavior's not unique.
(1'st position)
I don't want to live for those who know.
(1'st position)
They can buy but can't put on my clothes.
(1'st position)
I don't want to wait for them to walk.
(1'st position)
Never would have known of me before.
(1'st position)
I don't want to be held in your debt.
(1'st position)
I'll pay it off in blood then I'll be wed.
(1'st position)
I'm already cut up and half dead.
(1'st position)
I'll end up alone like I began.
(1'st position)
I don't want to take what you can give.
(1'st position)
I would rather starve than eat your breast.
(1'st position)
All the things that others want from me.
(1'st position)

[chorus]
(1'st position)

[chorus]
(1'st position)
